election: 2007 Takoma Park City Council Special Election - Ward 5
notes: PrefLib file 00023-00000001.toi (dataset 00023, 'takomapark'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 2 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

label_sources.official_winners: City of Takoma Park newsletter, 1 Apr 2012 (https://documents.takomaparkmd.gov/news/newsletter/2012/20120401-takoma-park-city-newsletter.pdf): Snipper was elected in the 2007 Ward 5 special election.
label_sources.date: FairVote, "Takoma Park Unveils New Voting Method" (29 Jan 2007): Ward 5 vacancy election on Tuesday, January 30.
label_sources.max_ranks: Ballots in the file rank up to all 3 named candidates.
